Formula closeness = totalCost > 0 ? (reachedPartial[0] - 1) / totalCost : 0, per pivot. Outward closeness: totalCost is the f32 sum of the search costs of every node the pivot reaches (infinite costs are skipped), added by a fixed 256-lane tree reduction so the value does not depend on thread order. reachedPartial[0] counts the reached nodes including the pivot itself. The Wasserman-Faust factor (r - 1) / (N - 1) is not applied; the unit is 1 / cost (1 / second on travel-time weights).
